fields.description: ELO 3 is a one- and two-bedroom apartment development within DAMAC Hills 2. Curved balconies distinguish the building, while its leisure spaces include a swimming pool, gym and outdoor cinema. It follows the original ELO and ELO 2 releases, with its own apartment drawings and commercial references.

reviewCoverage.residences: One/two-bedroom configurations checked against own plan pages 28–38.

overview: The plan pack distinguishes repeated A-series apartments from larger B-series options. For two-bedroom Type B2, balcony geometry changes by floor and the printed total ranges from 948 to 1,078 sq ft. A buyer should compare the exact floor-specific drawing and registered area, rather than treating a sample balcony as universal.
research.locationNote: The developer places ELO 3 in DAMAC Hills 2, Dubailand. Shared parks, sports and water recreation belong to the wider master community; exact walking routes, transport needs and access arrangements should be checked for the chosen building.
research.priceNote: The reviewed sales presentation starts one-bedroom homes at AED 580,000 and two-bedroom homes at AED 855,000. These are original launch guides. Later advertisements and resale listings may differ and do not establish currently available developer stock.
research.paymentNote: The original launch plan is 70/ 30: 20% immediately, 40% in timed instalments, 5% at each of the 80% and 90% construction milestones, and 30% on completion. The presentation also gives a separate 80/ 20 regular option. Exact current terms require a unit-specific schedule.
research.handoverNote: The original sales presentation states June 2027 and Bayut reports Q2 2027. Betterhomes gives August 2027. The headline therefore retains the year only; confirm the current contractual date before relying on a month or quarter.

facts.label: Document area discrepancy
facts.value: The presentation summary ranges are 528–646 and 773–1,084 sq ft; individual brochure drawings instead show 525–646 and 775–1,078. The table uses the drawing labels, and the unit's approved area still needs confirmation.
